scientific_integrity: Theorem proved analytically; finite exact-rational checks are supporting evidence, not exhaustive certification; no new claim to the universal bound or its equality classification.
scientific_limitations: Quantitative statement is restricted to the specified six-blocker chamber and lattice normalization, with deficit at most 1/90.
The exponent 1/2 is sharp in this class, but the numerical coefficient 10 and the allowed deficit threshold are not asserted optimal.
No global stability over other blocking chambers or all planar convex bodies is claimed.
Possible prior unindexed quantitative calculation not excluded; the 2001 predecessor was available only as abstract.
title: Sharp square-root stability of the planar lattice-transference hexagon in its blocking chamber
